newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - June 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - June 13.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on June 13. Reuters has not verified these stories and does notvouch for their accuracy.
The Indonesian government is studying the possibility of merging seven state banks into a smaller number in a bid to improve their competitiveness.
The new information minister General Raden Hartono said he would consider reviewing the 1984 ministerial decree that empowers him to revoke the publishing licences of newspapers and magazines.
The government has announced that the fund raising programme to finance the Southeast Asian Games (SEA Games) in October in Jakarta will continue.

The ruling Golkar party has said it has not made any decision yet whether to give some of the votes it obtained in the May 29 general elections to the fragmented Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI). The PDI only secured 10 seats at the House of Representatives, which is less than the minimum 11 seats.
